businessChecks.name: 库存月末与期初流水一致
businessChecks.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUBSTR(movement_date,1,7) m,SUM(quantity_delta) delta FROM stock_movements GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id,SUBSTR(movement_date,1,7)), a AS (SELECT i.warehouse_id,i.product_id,i.snapshot_date,i.quantity,o.quantity+SUM(COALESCE(m.delta,0)) OVER(PARTITION BY i.warehouse_id,i.product_id ORDER BY i.snapshot_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) expected FROM inventory_snapshots i JOIN inventory_opening o ON o.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND o.product_id=i.product_id LEFT JOIN m ON m.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND m.product_id=i.product_id AND m.m=SUBSTR(i.snapshot_date,1,7)) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM a WHERE quantity<>expected

businessChecks.name: 收货关联采购一致
businessChecks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goods_receipts g JOIN purchase_order_items i ON i.po_item_id=g.po_item_id JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.po_id=i.po_id WHERE p.status='cancelled' OR g.receipt_date<p.order_date

businessChecks.name: 销售库存出库数量一致
businessChecks.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT order_item_id,SUM(-quantity_delta) sold FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='sale' GROUP BY order_item_id) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=i.order_id LEFT JOIN a ON a.order_item_id=i.order_item_id WHERE (o.status='completed' AND COALESCE(a.sold,0)<>i.quantity) OR (o.status<>'completed' AND a.sold IS NOT NULL)

businessChecks.name: 退货数量不超原销售
businessChecks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT i.order_item_id,i.quantity,SUM(r.quantity) q FROM order_items i JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id=i.order_item_id GROUP BY i.order_item_id,i.quantity HAVING SUM(r.quantity)>i.quantity) a

businessChecks.name: 凭证借贷平衡
businessChecks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT entry_id FROM journal_lines GROUP BY entry_id HAVING SUM(debit_cents)<>SUM(credit_cents)) a

businessChecks.name: 员工任职区间不重叠
businessChecks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employment_history a JOIN employment_history b ON a.employee_id=b.employee_id AND a.employment_id<b.employment_id WHERE a.start_date<COALESCE(b.end_date,'9999-12-31') AND b.start_date<COALESCE(a.end_date,'9999-12-31')

businessChecks.name: 线上会话客户日期一致
businessChecks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customer_sessions s ON s.session_id=o.session_id WHERE o.customer_id<>s.customer_id OR o.order_date<>s.session_date

businessChecks.name: 合同商品供应商有效期一致
businessChecks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_order_items i JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.po_id=i.po_id JOIN supplier_contracts s ON s.contract_id=i.contract_id WHERE p.supplier_id<>s.supplier_id OR i.product_id<>s.product_id OR p.order_date NOT BETWEEN s.start_date AND s.end_date

businessChecks.name: 发票明细与采购订单一致
businessChecks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM supplier_invoice_items i JOIN supplier_invoices s ON s.supplier_invoice_id=i.supplier_invoice_id JOIN purchase_order_items p ON p.po_item_id=i.po_item_id WHERE p.po_id<>s.po_id

businessChecks.name: 库存成本历史匹配
businessChecks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_snapshots i JOIN product_costs p ON p.product_id=i.product_id AND p.effective_date=CONCAT(SUBSTR(i.snapshot_date,1,4),'-01-01') WHERE i.unit_cost_cents<>p.unit_cost_cents

boundaryTests.name: 删除一笔收货入库后，核对查询必须报告该收货
增加一分钱付款后足额发票变超额
减少一分钱结算后产生订单核对差额

mutation.sql: UPDATE payments SET amount_cents=amount_cents-1 WHERE payment_id=?
